headline: Hold it under your chin.
Then you know.
line: If your face lights up, it's yours. If the colour wins, leave it on the rack.

headline: Everything goes
with everything.
line: A wardrobe in one colour family: getting dressed takes a minute.

headline: Your best colour,
right where they look.
line: Wear your strongest colour close to your face. The rest can be quiet.

headline: Remembered for
the right reasons.
line: The right colour makes your face the first thing people notice.

headline: Less choice.
Better choices.
line: A wardrobe in your colours: fewer mistakes, more favourites.

headline: Deep, rich
and still you.
line: Your season tells you which dark colours work for you, and which ones swallow you.

headline: Walk in
like you mean it.
line: Clear colours for a clear colouring. No grey cardigan required.

headline: Warm colours,
warm first impression.
line: Light, warm shades make your face look fresh and open.
